2026-07-19.title: Nvidia DGX Spark as a daily driver
2026-07-19.description:
I bought an NVIDIA DGX Spark!
It's actually quite a competent general purpose computer while being super tiny and power efficient.
It basically just has an ARM CPU, a decent NVIDIA GPU (with the same number of CUDA cores as the RTX 5070), 128 GB of unified memory, and a 4 TB SSD.
